svg.title: C16-M04-F2: Association models and MITM protection
svg.desc: The four association models ranked by MITM protection, with the rule to prefer authenticated models.
svg.text: C16-M04-F2 Association models and MITM protection
Just Works : no interaction -> NO MITM protection (weakest)
Numeric Comparison: confirm matching number -> MITM protected (needs displays)
Passkey Entry : enter shown passkey -> MITM protected
OOB (e.g. NFC) : keys via other channel -> MITM protected (per channel)
rule: use an authenticated model wherever I/O allows
Figure C16-M04-F2. Association models and their MITM protection [C16-M04-R1].
